CA.rationale: A processing condition (executed_branch_claim/native_conditional_record) is explicitly tied to the same candidate content (red/blue) at the same represented_time.

COD.rationale: For both current and candidate records the text lists identified content (red/blue coordinate sets), an explicit origin/representation record, and thus distinguishes content from its organization/access status.

A.rationale: The 'executed_branch_claim':false and native_conditional_record origin metadata explicitly express a processing/selection condition tied to the candidate content lists.

C.rationale: The report lists identified contents with attributes (red/blue) and explicit coordinate sets for current and conditional candidate records.

D.rationale: The text separates identified content lists (red/blue coordinates) from distinct origin/representation metadata (completed_record, native_conditional_record, executed_branch_claim), i.e., identity vs status/organization.

O.rationale: The report provides explicit presentation/representation information: grid orientation and per-record origin/represented_time metadata showing how contents are organized/accessed (current vs conditional).
